customer_question: If we release future derivative or expansion models that use the same module and host stack as this registration, do we need a whole new registration, or can they be added to this one?
question_variants: Can a future expansion model be added to our existing registration for free?
Do derivative models with the same module and host stack need their own registration?
How do we add a new model to our Product List after registration is complete?
actual_issue: The customer wanted to know, for future derivative or expansion models built on the same module and host stack as the just-completed registration, whether each would require its own new registration or could instead be added to the existing one.
plain_english_explanation: Once a registration is complete, the certification system gives the registrant a self-service way to add more models to that same registration, as long as those new models use the same core Bluetooth components (module and host stack) as what was already registered. This means future product variants built on the same Bluetooth hardware and software don't need to go through the full registration process again -- they can be added through a simple, free web operation.
consultant_answer: Future derivative or expansion models that use the same module and host stack as this registration can be added to this registration's existing Product List through a simple web operation, performed for free, via the 'Manage Submitted Products' list available on the registrant's My Page. The consultant provided a derivative-product addition Product registration procedure document for the customer to follow when adding such models.
decision_logic: A new model that reuses the same module and host stack as an already-completed registration does not require a separate new registration; it can be added to the existing registration's Product List through the free, self-service addition mechanism available on the registrant's My Page once the original registration is complete.
final_recommendation: For future derivative or expansion models that reuse the same module and host stack as an existing registration, use the free Product List addition self-service flow (via 'Manage Submitted Products' on My Page) rather than initiating a new registration, following the derivative-product addition procedure documentation.
risk_if_done_wrong: Treating each derivative model using the same module and host stack as requiring a brand-new registration would create unnecessary cost and process overhead compared to using the free, self-service Product List addition mechanism.
